placements.domain: (first third-party site to install the widget)
placements.method: Third-party installs the /embed snippet. The attribution anchor sits in the host page's own markup, outside the iframe, so it is a real external link the host editorially places and controls.
placements.relevance: Anyone explaining reconstitution arithmetic can frame a working calculator instead of rebuilding one. The link is on a page about the same subject as the destination.
placements.nextStep: The mechanism shipped in this change. Add one record per host page as installs appear in referrer data or a site: search, then run the verifier: a snippet that carried no rel can still be output with rel="ugc" or rel="nofollow" by the host's CMS.
placements.notes: This is the only channel here that scales without a submission, and it is the one Google scrutinises most. Compliance rests on three properties asserted by scripts/test-embed.ts: the anchor text is a brand credit rather than a commercial keyword, the pasted markup tells the publisher they may reword it, add rel="nofollow", or delete it, and removing it does not disable the widget.

placements.method: Free listing created in the site's own submission flow. No email outreach.
placements.relevance: A long-established directory of software and web tools, organised by what a tool is an alternative to. A free browser-based calculator is squarely in scope, and the audience is people looking for exactly this kind of utility.
placements.nextStep: Needs an account on the platform, which needs an authorised identity and a mailbox the owner controls. Once the listing is live, record the listing URL here and run the verifier.
placements.notes: Attribute unverified and genuinely in doubt: sources disagree on whether the official-website field on a listing is dofollow, and it has changed before. Do not record this as dofollow on the strength of the directory's reputation.

placements.method: Self-submitted product post.
placements.relevance: High-traffic launch platform. Relevance to a measurement utility is moderate: the audience is general-purpose rather than people reconstituting anything.
placements.nextStep: Decide whether it is worth the effort at all. Kept in the register mainly as the clearest example of why domain authority is not the criterion.

placements.method: Create or extend the structured item for the site as an entity, with the official-website property.
placements.relevance: Not a ranking link. It is the entity record that search and AI answer engines reconcile against, which is the GEO half of the same job.
placements.nextStep: Only worth doing if the site meets the project's own notability and sourcing expectations. Judge that honestly first; an item that does not belong there will be deleted and the effort wasted.
placements.notes: Expected nofollow. Recorded so the value claimed for it stays accurate: entity clarity and knowledge-graph reconciliation, not link equity.

placements.method: Publish the reconstitution arithmetic in src/lib/calc as a standalone open-source package with the site as its homepage field. Registry aggregators then generate pages that render that homepage URL, without anyone being contacted.
placements.relevance: Strong and durable. The package is the same tested arithmetic the site runs, so the homepage link is a genuine provenance link rather than a placement, and the pages that carry it are about the library itself.
placements.nextStep: Two blockers, both real. It needs a publish token for the registry, and it needs a decision on maintaining a public package (versioning, issues, a licence). Neither is settled, so nothing has been published.
placements.notes: The registry's own project page and the aggregators differ in whether they nofollow the homepage field, and they differ from each other. Every aggregator page has to be verified individually; none may be counted from the package existing.

placements.method: Self-deposit the methodology and its worked arithmetic as a citable record with a DOI. Self-service, no outreach, no gatekeeper.
placements.relevance: Good fit if and only if the deposit is a real, standalone document worth citing. A deposit made to obtain a link is not, and would be the wrong thing to publish.
placements.nextStep: Decide whether the methodology is genuinely a citable artifact separate from the page. If it is, it needs an account, an author identity, and a licence choice by the owner.
placements.notes: Attribute unverified. Repository record pages frequently nofollow related-identifier and homepage links, so treat the value as citability and discovery until the verifier says otherwise.

placements.method: Answer reconstitution arithmetic questions where they are already being asked, linking the calculator only where it actually answers the question.
placements.relevance: The highest topical relevance available and the most likely to send people who need the tool.
placements.nextStep: Not started, and not something to automate. It needs a real, identified participant who can stand behind answers on a health-adjacent subject. Posting under a manufactured persona would be misrepresentation, and drive-by links are removed by moderators anyway.
placements.notes: Expected nofollow or ugc almost everywhere, which is the correct outcome for a community link. Recorded because the traffic and the credibility are the point, not the attribute.
